summary: Iteration 8 - DutyConnect Phase A (industry-neutral branding) + Phase B (Free gating) frontend E2E, viewport 390x844, user delivered+t1@resend.dev (Free). All in-scope flows PASS except two issues (one BUG + one placeholder/branding leak): (1) BRANDING: welcome, login, home, shifts, upgrade, profile screens are clean (no 'Prison', 'HMPPS', 'Bed Watch', 'PP' or 'Officer' wording). Shifts tab header reads 'My Shifts'. Shift form 'Shift type' row offers Standard shift / Overtime / Extra shift / Other (plus the Weekend overtime template), 'Your name' label present. Profile categories list is neutral (Healthcare, Security, Emergency services, Logistics & warehouse, Manufacturing, Hospitality, Transport, Retail, Other). BUT: on the Account screen the Personal details ROW VALUE still displays the user's legacy `professional_category='Prison Officer'` (stored on this test account from before Phase A) — the picker list is neutral, but the stored value is not. This is a legacy-data residue the main agent may need to migrate/backfill for existing Phase A users. (2) 3-SHIFT LIMIT: with 3 booked future shifts seeded, tapping home-quick-add-shift (and the Shifts FAB) renders shift-limit-screen with shift-limit-pro-prompt verbatim 'Unlimited shifts with Pro' / 'Plus full history, multiple payments, reports and sync on all devices.'. After deleting one future shift, Add shift opens the full form again. (3) 7-DAY HISTORY: effectively a 20-day-old 'AB Old20d' completed shift is NOT delivered to the client (server-side history_days=7 strips it from the sync response) and does not appear in the calendar day or List → History; a 3-day-old 'AB Recent3d' shift is visible. BUT history-older-prompt is NOT shown because the frontend FREE_HISTORY_DAYS = 30 (/app/frontend/src/billing/entitlement.tsx:85) which never matches 20-day-old shifts, and because the server already filtered them, olderHidden is always 0 → the prompt body also says 'Free shows the last 30 days' (/app/frontend/src/components/shift-list-view.tsx:108). HIGH-priority mismatch: the comparison table and spec say 7 days but the client constant is 30. (4) HOME: card titled 'This week' present on Free. earnings-pro-prompt visible on Earnings tab with the 'This week' label. (5) EXPORT: earnings-export-button opens export-sheet; on Free export-pro-prompt is shown with body 'A free copy of all your personal data is always available: Account → Download my data.', no export-csv-button, no export-pdf-button. export-close-button is fully in viewport at 390x844 (y=776, h=52, bottom=828 < 844). (6) ACCOUNT: account-data-download-row 1st tap downloads JSON (DutyConnect-my-data-2026-10-12.json); 2nd tap shows an info toast about the 7-day limit — BUT the support email in the toast is a placeholder: 'Self-service download available again on 2026-10-19. Need it sooner? Email support@YOUR-DOMAIN.example — it's free.' That literal 'YOUR-DOMAIN.example' should be replaced before launch. account-templates-row opens templates-screen; adding 'Weekend overtime' 09:00-17:00 lists the template and the add form is replaced by templates-pro-prompt 'Unlimited templates with Pro / Free includes one custom template. Existing templates are always kept.'. After freeing a slot and opening Add shift, the Weekend overtime template shows as shift-duty-t_* option and pre-fills start=09:00 / end=17:00. (7) UPGRADE: comparison testID upgrade-comparison present with the new rows Feature/Free/Pro: 'Up to 3', 'Last 7 days', 'One' payment, 'This week' earnings, 'One phone' sync, 'One' custom template. No £ prices on web (zero £-digit matches). 'Prices are shown by Google Play in your local currency.' present. upgrade-unavailable-note visible. (8) REGRESSION: Recently Deleted route reachable, payments panel on the recent completed shift (with one existing £50 payment) shows payment-pro-prompt and no payment-add-button, sync badge renders (testID sync-status-badge/sync-status-text, not sync-badge). Carryover console warnings only: 'shadow* style props are deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (pre-existing from iteration 1).

ui_bugs.issue: FREE_HISTORY_DAYS=30 on the client but server returns history_days=7 and strips older shifts from sync. Net effect for Free: history-older-prompt NEVER appears (olderHidden stays 0) and when it would, its body still reads 'Free shows the last 30 days'. Fix: set FREE_HISTORY_DAYS=7 in /app/frontend/src/billing/entitlement.tsx:85 and update the body copy in /app/frontend/src/components/shift-list-view.tsx:108 to 'last 7 days'. Alternatively compute olderHidden from the server-provided plan.features.history_days.

Placeholder support email in the 2nd-tap info toast on account-data-download-row: 'Self-service download available again on 2026-10-19. Need it sooner? Email support@YOUR-DOMAIN.example - it's free.' The literal 'YOUR-DOMAIN.example' should be replaced with the real support address before launch.

The row value shows the legacy 'Prison Officer' because the test user's stored professional_category pre-dates Phase A. The picker options are neutral, but there is no migration/backfill so existing users keep an old industry-specific label.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/billing/entitlement.tsx:85 FREE_HISTORY_DAYS = 30 — contradicts the server (features.history_days = 7 in /app/backend/server.py:56) and the upgrade comparison row 'Last 7 days' in /app/frontend/app/upgrade.tsx:18. Any Free client logic that depends on this constant (shift-list-view.tsx:45-46, 108) is one source-of-truth away from the backend.

/app/frontend/src/components/shift-list-view.tsx:104-110 olderHidden is computed client-side as `s.date < cutoff`, but when the server pre-strips older shifts for Free, the client never knows there are older shifts and olderHidden is always 0 — so the user never sees the 'Free shows the last 7 days…' hint. Consider surfacing the count from the server (e.g. a `history_truncated_count` field in /api/shifts/sync) so the ProPrompt is driven by truth.

rca_of_issue: history-older-prompt bug RCA: /app/frontend/src/billing/entitlement.tsx:85 declares FREE_HISTORY_DAYS = 30 while /app/backend/server.py:56 declares features.history_days = 7 for Free. The server pre-filters shifts older than 7 days out of the sync response, so the client's own history filter (shift-list-view.tsx:45-46) never fires (0 shifts match `s.date < today-30`), olderHidden = 0, and the ProPrompt is never rendered. Reproduction: insert a 10-day-old completed pp_shift for a Free user, pull sync — the shift is excluded; on the client it never appears in History and the 'older shifts safely stored' hint never shows. Mitigation: set FREE_HISTORY_DAYS = 7 and update the hint copy to 'Free shows the last 7 days', OR add a server-provided truncated_count so the ProPrompt is data-driven. Account data-download toast RCA: a literal 'YOUR-DOMAIN.example' is embedded in the toast string (likely in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/account.tsx or wherever the toast is composed) and never substituted — a placeholder shipped to runtime. Fix: replace with the real support@dutyconnect.app (or similar) address.
